statement: WiiBrew's Wii Motion Plus introduction describes games probing the two-byte expansion identifier at 0xA600FE as many as three times before an eight-second delay and another probe. Reading that identifier returns memory error 7 if MotionPlus is absent or already activated; later the page also describes regular polling of 0xA600FE roughly every eight seconds while MotionPlus is inactive. These are community-reported host-side detection and re-probe patterns, not a per-report cadence or mandatory hardware latency.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew community documented Wii Remote family; precise physical hardware variant not independently captured
applicability.scope: WiiBrew Wii Motion Plus oldid 120079: introduction's discovery paragraph (three tries, eight-second wait and error 7) plus later paragraph beginning 'When not activated' (approximately eight-second polling). Separate from kernel four-second host polling and device timing.
